design_system.theme: Sunny Coop v3 — same chunky farming-sim visual language as v2, scaled from a 2-page thin guide into an 8-page content site (~3x content)
kept_from_v2: Saturated farm palette (sky blue hero gradient, barn red, hay yellow, pasture green, deep brown ink)
Chunky game-UI components: 2-3px ink borders, hard offset shadows, pressed-state buttons, pill badges
Layered animated CSS hero farm scene on the homepage
Night-farm dark progression section with LV chips
new_in_v3: Page-hero component for subpages: sky gradient, centered badge/headline/copy, primary CTA to #quick-start, meta chips with check dates
Chunky .fact-table pattern (hay-yellow header, rounded bordered wrapper, horizontal scroll only inside the wrapper on small screens)
.callout and .callout-warn dashed policy boxes used for 'why no list' honesty blocks
.dir-card directory grid turning the homepage into a hub for all system pages
.update-band spotlight card for Update 7 on the homepage
Feature grids reused across subpages for advice cards
design_system.font_strategy: System-first sans for body (Inter stack) with Arial Rounded MT Bold / Trebuchet MS fallbacks for chunky display headings; no external font dependency.
responsive_rules: 375px: single column everywhere, full-width CTAs, hamburger nav, scene scaled with small decorations hidden, tables scroll inside their wrapper only (page itself never scrolls horizontally)
768px: single-column hero, two-column card grids, non-sticky guide contents
1440px: 1160px content shell, two-column hero, three/four-column grids
html/body use overflow-x: clip; verified scrollWidth === viewport width at 375/768/1440 on all 8 pages via headless browser
prefers-reduced-motion disables animations and smooth scroll

fact_usage_policy.mutable_data_rule: Game-pass prices, Update 7 contents, code behavior, Lucky Block details, rebirth/reset/Skip behavior, and group rewards are always shown with the 2026-08-20 check date and an in-game confirmation prompt.
excluded_claims: Any current promo-code string or table (no code list is approved)
Any rebirth cost/multiplier number or cap (conflicting tables rejected)
Complete chicken tier tree or chicken count
Gem Upgrade effects or costs beyond the Rebirth 3 unlock
Live CCU, visits, votes, or member counts
fact_usage_policy.external_links: Only the official Roblox game page is linked; the Discord invite is mentioned as plain text, never as a URL.
